svg.text: 30 fps · 151 frames · same session in A, B and C
A: 77 body joints estimated by GEM-X from a phone video. B: the same motion solved by OpenSim inverse kinematics on
the Rajagopal musculoskeletal model (Rajagopal et al. 2016; Lai et al. 2017; Uhlrich et al. 2022), drawn with its bone
geometry and 80 muscle paths. C: four of the resulting joint angles.
